art_direction: 浅水青底柔赭双眼，低阔半眯，漫不经心地斜看。
composition_variation: Make both eyes low, broad, and only thirty-five percent open. The viewer-left lid lifts slightly at its inner end, while the viewer-right lid rests lower through its middle, creating controlled unequal pressure. Keep the eye centers nearly level. Both pupils look toward viewer-right and slightly upward, retaining enough colored area around them for the direction to read clearly. This is a brief sidelong look of cool dismissal, with graceful curves rather than extreme squinting or dramatic diagonal shapes.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
